comhad apt repository

Debian and Ubuntu packages for comhad, a ranger-style terminal browser for S3. amd64 and arm64, Debian 12 or newer and Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. 

sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/comhad.gpg https://eoin-mcmahon.github.io/comhad/comhad.gpg
sudo install -m 0644 /tmp/comhad.gpg /etc/apt/keyrings/comhad.gpg
echo "deb [arch=amd64,arm64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/comhad.gpg] https://eoin-mcmahon.github.io/comhad stable main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/comhad.list > /dev/null
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install comhad

comhad.gpg is the repository's public signing key. Check it with gpg --show-keys --with-fingerprint /etc/apt/keyrings/comhad.gpg before trusting it: 

Comhad Repository Signing Key <eoin.mcmahon.dev@gmail.com>
2241 CE8E D086 4E41 2EF1  A9F8 ED2B 3218 F62A 210B

There is a one-command version of the above at install.sh. What it writes, what trust it grants, and how to remove it again are documented in docs/apt-repository.md. Other install methods are listed in the README.
